items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: I say, Magnus, he wasn't going to school

ctx.x: No, I wasn't working there when school was open. I don't think so. And I worked there. I had a place on Canal Street. I think it was a white jewelry store. Then I worked for Whirline, when Boerese, Miss Boerese had it. And after he found out my ability, he really knew Perkins, because Perkins used to come in the Groomwall store and had a Whirline store, which is still there. And I was supposed to run the elevator and help him behind the—keep stocks of all the things like strings and like things for the horns and…
When did you start playing music professionally for, you know, your first few jobs?
